guide.title: Printing your QR code well
guide.size: Size: at least 2 × 2 cm for the code, 3 cm recommended. Larger on a poster seen from afar (about 1 cm per 10 cm of distance).
guide.contrast: Contrast: a dark code on a light background. A colour that’s too light won’t scan.
guide.noDistort: Don’t distort it: keep the code square, resize it from a corner, without stretching or cropping it.
guide.margin: Keep the margin: the white band around the code is part of the QR; nothing on it.
guide.test: Test before printing in bulk: print one copy and scan it with two phones.
guide.formats: For your designs (Canva, Illustrator, Word): use the SVG or PDF (sharp at any size), with a transparent background on a light background.
